short_term_14d: J&J receives EU approval for new treatment for generalized myosthenia grav IS.
Johnson & Johnson received European Commission approval for new Fc Rn blocker IMAAV Y® (n ipocalimab). - Leslie Storm s left J&J to become President of Ethos veterinary Health and investor in NVA.
CMS covers J&J's cardiac ablations in ambulitary surgery centers. - Wall Street pushes J&Js market value towards $50 billion.
